description: Edit a photo you already have: change one thing and keep the rest. Pass the image URL and describe ONLY what should change, plus what must stay ("keep the face and background as they are") — that sentence is what decides whether the edit holds.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to edit.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to Nano Banana 2.

prompt.description: The change to make, and what must stay unchanged.

name: edit_image
title: Edit an image
